unit.evidence: 146 unit cases: 30 validator cases, 15 delivery gate cases, 13 completeness matrix cases, 11 lesson validation cases, 11 memory policy cases, 10 command reproducibility cases, 9 cross-tool validation cases, 9 quality evidence cases, 7 preflight cases, 6 status and blocker cases, 6 memory structure cases, 6 milestone policy cases, 4 recurrence cases, 3 adapter cases, 2 derived requirement cases, 2 checklist cases, and 2 verdict vocabulary cases.

integration.evidence: 34 isolated Git and subprocess cases: 8 delta inventory cases, 6 detached-HEAD cases, 5 historical compatibility cases covering every sealed tag, 4 checkpoint lifecycle cases, 4 finalization attempt recording cases, 4 Green Keeper harness cases, 2 finalization ledger cases, 1 resealed blocker reproduction, and 1 end-to-end delivery lifecycle case that now includes the lesson preflight.
